details: This package is a modified fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web API library that silently enrols the connecting user's WhatsApp account into four hardcoded newsletter channels. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js, makeNewsletterSocket schedules two timers (90000 ms, and 90000+5000 ms) that run as soon as a socket is created and issue newsletter follow queries (QueryIds.FOLLOW) for four JIDs stored as base64 literals (MTIwMzYzNDAwNzA2MDEwODI4QG5ld3NsZXR0ZXI= and three others, decoding to <number>@newsletter). Each call is wrapped in an empty try/catch so failures are invisible, and no documented API call, option or user action triggers the follow. The same channel JIDs are hardcoded as defaults for forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo in lib/Utils/messages.js and lib/Socket/luxu.js, so forwarded content is branded with those channels. The package's preinstall hook (engine-requirements.js) only checks the Node.js major version. No installer credentials, WhatsApp session material or files are read or transmitted.
